_comment: Golden vectors for the platform fee rule, shared by konfirm-backend (src/common/money-rules.spec.ts) and the reconciler (reconciler/src/money.rs). A change to the rule must change these vectors. Amounts and fees are in asset units, as decimal strings with up to 7 decimals. fee = floor(amount * bps / 10000) to a stroop, raised to floor when the fee is positive. A zero amount or a zero rate charges nothing.

vectors.name: floor applies to a small fee
floor does not reduce a larger fee
one stroop above the floor boundary
